svg.title: Blue Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry and interpretive screen colours. Shaped blue support reconstructed without the photographed wall, frame-like shadows or plinth. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for blue; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.glenstone.org/artworks/blue-curve; inspected2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation, not a facsimile.
